item.title: OpenAI’s EU AI Act Plan: Governance, Safety, Cyber
item.description: OpenAI outlines its comprehensive strategy to meet the EU AI Act, detailing governance frameworks, safety protocols, transparency tools, and a cyber action plan.

item.title: EU Mandates AI-Generated Content Labels Starting Aug 2
item.description: Starting Aug 2, the EU AI Act requires AI‑generated images, audio and text that look real to carry digital watermarks, with fines up to 3% of revenue.
